stageA.purpose: Make and interpret student/class-collected graphs, solve one- and two-step comparisons from authentic per-class data
stageA.essentialConstraint: L02 data comes from the class and MUST NOT be replaced with six fixed counts from L01.
stageA.coolDownPolicy: FIRST_PARTY_EQUIVALENT_AUTHORIZED; publisher login not required; original publisher Cool-down not claimed verified.

independentTeachingOutline: Show three dot arrangements and ask learners to describe grouping, including 8 to 10 difference.
Teacher collects actual class home travel choices; students make picture graph with title/key.
Learners convert the SAME class data to bar graph and discuss the role of scale.
Teacher fills compare-question category blanks; students state equations and oral justifications.
Never treat speculative class counts or copied publisher artwork as original classroom results.
authoredMathematicalActivities: Three independently drawn 6/8/10 dot groups with partner grouping and 8-to-10 explanation
Six editable class response categories, one response per learner and teacher-required provenance
Picture and bar graph representations from SAME user-provided dataset
Four actual-data true/false comparisons, one-step and two-step difference questions with typed data
Teacher rubric covering synthesis, partner interaction and mathematical community norms
Separate original fictional-club graph Cool-down with human-scored graph drawing
stageB.sourceChartVisualDefectFound: Originally six horizontal glyph rows and unscaled horizontal bars, not the source's vertical picture graph and bar graph.
stageB.sourceChartVisualCorrection: Vertical six-column first-party glyph pictograph, vertical bars sharing data/axis, maximum up to 40 authentic responses.
stageB.teachingNote: Teacher may adapt original six suggested categories; comparisons use teacher-chosen labels in the same source slot order.

numericCandidateRequirements: Use real, contextual class category counts as explicit validated parameters, no hardcoded answers from original source.
Provide correct comparisons and one/two-step category sums/differences within the stated lesson scope.
Reject missing or inconsistent datasets rather than guessing counts.
Free-form explanation, partner work, invented labels and generated student bar graph require human or explicitly rubric-driven review.
stageC.trueFalsePolicy: Calculated only from validated learner-supplied classroom category counts; teacher verifies authenticity.

openGaps: Teacher may choose a different number than six categories; the current first-party activity still offers six editable slots and cannot attest actual class survey provenance.
Original student task PDF and complete figure geometry remain unverified. Publisher Cool-down is gated but independent agreed Edulytics alternative exists.
Rich V2 effective published teaching body and student runtime Razor display have not been compared or exercised; Stage D testing intentionally deferred.
Teacher must attest actual sticky-note class survey, graph drawing, source comparison choices, Math Community work and source figure/material rights.
Automatic within-20 families avoid certifying comparisons outside scope; teacher adjusts when total counts exceed permitted arithmetic range.

edulyticsOriginalCoolDown.acceptanceRule: Publisher-login-only original Cool-down is NOT a blocker. Edulytics writes its own independently-authored goal- and skill-aligned Cool-down.
